analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, Kairat (27th, two points) host Craiova (8th, seven points) on matchday 5, after Kairat's home game with Mjällby on 26 November. Craiova have conceded twice in three games (1-1 with Getafe, 3-1 at Inter Escaldes, 2-0 against Egnatia); Kairat's home record so far is a 5-1 defeat by Panathinaikos. I found no recent domestic news for either side, and this will change with the matchday 4 results.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I lean a little lower: Craiova have kept their European games under control, conceding two in three, and Kairat's away draws at Riga and Atalanta were both 1-1. The 5-1 home defeat by Panathinaikos is the warning against going far below the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. Nothing I read moves this, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards, more of them for Craiova. With no referee and no disciplinary pattern for either side, I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.8 shots, split evenly. Nothing clear points either way this far out.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target, a high share of 24.8 shots. I lean slightly lower: Craiova's controlled style and Kairat's modest attack suggest fewer clean chances than that ratio implies.
